verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a tax-services portal could plausibly offer recurring or background automations, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature. The closest item is the ability to schedule a payment in advance, which is a one-off deferred action rather than a recurring automation running in the background. The probes also found no API or OpenAPI spec, and the transactional /e-services/ surface is disallowed for agents in robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With Web File, you can schedule payments in advance, save your bank account information for future use, and update your business information.
